name: TiDB AI Assistant
summary: Public AI assistant demo answering questions about TiDB with a knowledge-graph RAG pipeline.
description: A Perplexity-style conversational search app over TiDB docs and community content, built as the live demo of the open-source AutoFlow project. Ask questions, get answers with sources, keep a conversation history behind login, and query the public API.
contains: knowledge-graph RAG Q&A over TiDB docs
ask question dialog and conversations list
live demo of AutoFlow (3k GitHub stars, Apache-2.0)
embeddable chat widget in the project
